messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] sev-2: multiple rtf-serving pods experiencing GPU OOM -> container crash + node flaps. Affected pool: rtf-pool-3. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/6162024242

maria: ack, I'm the oncall. pinging infra, grabbing logs. which model variant?

devin: seeing repeated `cudaRuntimeError: out of memory` in runtime.log and allocator warnings: "kv_slot_fragmentation > 0.85". resident set for process 24321 rising ~180MB/hr on a handful of pods.

simon: pasted tail of runtime.log:```
2026-03-17T10:07:05Z runtime[24321]: attention_pager.cpp:452 WARN: page_alloc failed, fragmentation=0.87
2026-03-17T10:07:05Z runtime[24321]: allocator.cpp:981 ERROR: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-17T10:07:06Z runtime[24321]: kv_cache.cpp:223 INFO: slot_density=0.12, silt_accum=0.32
```

jules: can we quickly reduce cache pressure? propose disabling prefix caching for this model instance and force a compaction on affected nodes.

oncall: doing a quick restart of pod rtf-svc-7b-5 on gpu-07 to pull it out of bad state (graceful), will cordon if it flaps again.

alice: restarted pod — came up healthy for ~3m then node gpu-07 flapped (kubelet panic). collecting node kubelet logs now.

maria: mitigation checklist (short):
- cordon gpu-07
- drain other pods off nodes showing steady resident growth
- run offline `kv-compact` on drained nodes
- temporarily disable attention paging for model v2 on rtf-pool-3
- lower kv_eviction_threshold to 0.6 for the pool

simon: metric query (prometheus) that showed the drift: ```
avg_over_time(process_resident_bytes{job="rtf-runtime"}[3h]) by (instance)
```
shows a ~150-250MB upward slope per host for instances {gpu-05,gpu-07,gpu-09}.

jules: applying config changes now: `kubectl patch cm rtf-config -p '{"data":{"kv_eviction_threshold":"0.6","attention_paging":"false"}}'` then rolling restart of the pool. will also open incident ticket and notify CS about 3 customers seeing elevated 5xxs.

devin: customer impact: 3 customers with intermittent 500s and ~2x tail latency increase for generation routes. CS notified, letting them know we're mitigating.

oncall: starting compaction on gpu-05 now: `/opt/redwood/bin/kv-compact --node gpu-05 --max-runtime 600`

alice: kubelet logs show repeated `watch chan closed` immediately before panic; possibly exacerbated by oom-killer churn. saving logs to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/6162024242/gpu-07-kubelet.log

jules: rolling restart triggered, changes deployed. monitoring dashboards. will escalate to infra if node flapping continues after compaction.

devin: monitoring looks stabilizing on gpu-05 and gpu-09, gpu-07 still flapping — cordoned.
maria: good, keep watch. create follow-up tasks: deep-dive kv fragmentation root cause, add automated compaction when fragmentation > 0.8, and add a canary to exercise reduced batching for threshold tests.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] severity remains sev-2. last observed crash timestamp 6162024318. next automated check in 5m.
